instruction.text: Read the review and decide what kind of story it is about.

atoms.sound: Welcome back to Book Break. Today we’re talking about Skyline Run. It’s a science-fiction story set in a floating city, and the main character is a robot named R-9.
So is it just action and machines?
That’s what I expected, but no! R-9 starts as a simple service robot, fixing broken machines. But then he finds a data file he wasn’t supposed to see, and everything changes.
He starts thinking for himself. He questions the rules he was programmed to follow. The book becomes much more about choices and identity than about tech.
Very. The middle of the book slows down, but in a good way. You really get inside R-9's thoughts. The ending stayed with me after I finished reading.
Sounds deeper than a typical robot story.
Exactly — If you like science-fiction that also asks big questions, “Skyline Run” is worth reading.
